title: CDC says a pool fence should be four-sided, at least four feet high, and separate from the house
summary: CDC says to use a four-sided fence at least four feet high that fully encloses the pool and separates it from the house.
body: CDC's drowning-prevention page says to construct and use a four-sided fence at least four feet in height that fully encloses the pool. The fence should separate the pool from the house, and the gates should be self-closing and self-latching. Toys that might draw a child to the water should be removed when the pool is not in use. This is a US specification for a barrier. It is not the CPSC note about checking the pool first when a child is missing, and it is not a rescue method.

sources.title: Preventing Drowning
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US federal page, public domain. Page dated 29 September 2025. Supports the four-sided, four-foot fence sentence.
